entities.name: Chapter 6 Season 3
entities.description: The current season - 'Galactic Battle'. Star Wars theme with lightsabers, blasters and new POIs.
tips: New POIs: Vader Samurai's Solitude, First Order Base, Resistance Base, Outpost Enclave.
Vader Samurai's Solitude replaces Shogun's Solitude.
First Order Base replaces Demon's Dojo; Resistance Base replaces Whiffy Wharf.
Lightsabers are melee weapons that also grant movement bonuses.
Captain Phasma's F-11D Blaster comes from defeating Captain Phasma at First Order Base.

entities.name: POIs
entities.description: Named locations on the island where loot spawns. Each POI has a loot level and a risk.
tips: Land at a low-tier POI early to gear up, then rotate to a high-tier POI.
POIs with a named NPC usually have a vault - clear the NPC to open it.
Storm eye shrinks; rotate early rather than waiting for the final circle.
Check for the secret vault door - it is on the wall behind a framed picture.
High-traffic POIs like those in the city centre mean more players, not more loot.

entities.name: Lightsabers
entities.description: Melee weapons added in Season 3. They boost movement while equipped.
tips: Equipping a lightsaber lets you sprint faster and jump twice as high.
You are immune to fall damage while a lightsaber is out.
A Sith Lightsaber lets you throw the saber with a Force move - it arcs and returns.
You get the Sith Lightsaber by defeating Darth Vader Samurai.
Saber throw cooldown means you cannot spam it - throw once per engagement.

entities.name: Blasters
entities.description: The Star Wars weapon family added in Season 3 - pistol, SMG, shotguns, rifles, marksman rifles and a heavy blaster.
tips: DL-44 Blaster Pistol - close range sidearm.
CR-2 Blaster - heavy SMG, good for suppressing.
ACP Scatter Blaster and BARM-ST12 Scatter Blaster - shotguns.
DLT-19 - close to medium range blaster rifle.
IQA-11 Marksman - long range; A280-CFE is the all-purpose rifle.

entities.name: Proximity Warning System
entities.description: A high-tech sensor that warns you when an enemy is nearby.
tips: It warns you of enemies inside a short radius.
The warning makes YOU visible on the map - it is not a free information advantage.
It does NOT show the exact enemy position, only that one is close.
Disable or ignore it when you are about to fight - the warning gives away your spot.
Very useful in the endgame when you are hiding in a box or a bush.

entities.name: Building
entities.description: Fortnite's signature build mechanic - walls, ramps, floors and edits.
tips: Build in a spiral - floor, wall, ramp - not wall after wall.
Editing a wall opens a window you can peek and shoot through.
Edit on release for a quick window; hold and confirm for a full wall piece.
Never stop moving while building - a stationary builder dies.
On console, use the edit button and hold for the pie wheel.
Wood builds fastest, brick is tougher, metal is nearly indestructible but slow.

entities.name: Tanking
entities.description: Holding ground with your team instead of running away. Winning the fight by outlasting and out-positioning the enemy.
tips: Do not peek out of cover - wait for the enemy to come to you.
Use the storm edge: fight where the storm will push the enemy into you.
Keep a crossfire: two players on different angles means the enemy has to expose themselves.
Hold high ground but keep a rotation path so you are not trapped.
Save your explosives for the final fight - use them to break the enemy structure.

entities.name: Looting
entities.description: Finding weapons, ammo, shields and materials efficiently.
tips: Chest spawns give better loot than floor loot - rotate chest to chest.
Ammo type matters - check the ammo count before taking a gun.
Shield potions are more valuable than a medkit early - 50 shield beats 50 HP.
Gold is smelted into bars; it is not craftable into weapons.
A vault usually holds a mythic or above - the sound tells you someone else is there.
